notes: The sheet continues a description by fibers I_alpha and tilde A_alpha. It says that a standard pinned curve over the base corresponds to a relative curve for each vertex, with genus and marked-point data. It introduces the groupoid M_{g,I}(S), then M_G(S), and writes an equivalence with the product over alpha in S. This is a transcription summary, not an independent mathematical verification.

The first line literally names the fibers as those of I and plain A, while tilde A_alpha is written earlier in the same line. No tilde has been supplied to the second A. Both occurrences of the author’s spelling standart remain. The first G épinglée has no hyphen; the later G-épinglées has one.

The H-like short form before alpha has two independent stems with separate feet. Following the ink and the root-supplied letterform comparison, tt is preferred with a narrow forall alternative. It has not been expanded in the transcription.

The first connectedness digit is retained as 6|0 after the independent audit: its tall entry and lower loop favor the six-like shape, independently of what the mathematics might suggest. The later zero in 0-connexes is round and clear. The word sur remains doubtful because its initial is retraced.

The canceled indexed M was first corrected by a raised hatted I and then canceled as a whole. The lower alpha is visible, but its attachment to the raised replacement is not securely written at the raised level. The later g also has an obscured canceled index. These source states are retained without filling missing raised ink.

The circled formula, leftward arrow and (19) label are already acknowledged by H’s note; they are not classified as H omissions. The three-stroke relation in (21) is approxeq, with two waves and a straight bottom bar. The source itself calls this an equivalence.
The bottom 18 is separate pale pagination with unidentified authorship. No dark page number is visible at the head of this sheet.

Independent audit: the two separate stems and feet before alpha favor tt, unlike the converging universal sign on scan018 B07; the forall alternative remains. The first connectedness digit now prefers 6 over 0 from its tall entry and lower loop, while the later round zero stays clear. This is an uncertain ink reading, not a correction of the mathematical statement. Both live spellings are standart, and no hyphen is supplied across the opening au dessus line break. The raised hatted-I replacement retains the uncertainty of its alpha attachment. The canceled later index admits nu as well as alpha, and the canceled category word is now explicitly uncertain in its hidden ending. Entier naturel has no separately visible final s. The open oval, leftward arrow to (19), underlined I-ponctuées, two hooked arrows and complete formulas (20)/(21) were rechecked visually. The final relation has two waves over a straight bar. No independent groupoid-equivalence proof was performed.
